description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based inference application using TFLite Micro and Ethos-U NPU, managing inference jobs and threading.

classes.name: InferenceProcessParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for inference processing including queue handle, tensor arena, and size.

classes.name: xInferenceJob
classes.description: Extends InferenceJob with response queue and status for Zephyr multitasking.

methods.name: allocateHeap
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a heap for inference tasks.

methods.name: inferenceProcessTask
methods.description: Runs inference jobs from a queue, processing each job and sending responses.

methods.name: inferenceSenderTask
methods.description: Creates inference jobs, queues them, and waits for their completion status.
